titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Prophecy of Christ in Solomon (ch. 66)
part: ch. 66 — The Prophecy of Christ in Solomon
about: A short interpretive chapter: Solomon is read as a type of Christ, his Temple as Christ’s body and church, his foreign wives as the Gentiles gathered in, the sixty mighty men of the Song of Songs as the saints; Psalms 2, 72 and 110 are claimed against the Jews who apply them only to Solomon, and Solomon is affirmed as prophet and saved.

sentences.i: Chapter 66: Concerning the prophecy of Christ.
sentences.n: ፷፮ = 66 (፷ 60 + ፮ 6), a numeral. The heading is its own unit. በእንተ 'concerning' takes the construct state, so ትንቢተ ክርስቶስ is 'prophecy-of Christ' (ትንቢት becomes ትንቢተ before the dependent noun).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ብሂል ፡ በስዉር ፡ ነገር ፡ በፍካሬ ፡ ትንቢት ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ብሂል ።
sentences.l: for Solomon saying in-hidden matter in-interpretation-of prophecy Christ saying
sentences.i: For 'Solomon' means, in a hidden way of speaking and by the interpretation of prophecy, 'Christ'.
sentences.n: እስመ 'for, because' opens the explanation. ብሂል is the verbal noun of ብህለ 'say' (the root of ይቤ) ('a saying, it is said, it means'); used twice, it frames the equation Solomon = Christ, a typological reading rather than an etymology. በስዉር ነገር 'in a hidden matter' (ስዉር 'hidden', ነገር 'word, matter'). በፍካሬ ትንቢት: ፍካሬ 'interpretation, exposition' in construct with ትንቢት 'prophecy'. ስዉር may be the adjective 'hidden' or the noun 'secret' (then 'in a secret of speech'); I take the adjective (?). 'Means' for ብሂል is my choice; 'is called' is possible (?).

sentences.t: ወበከመ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ሐነጸ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ክርስቶስኒ ፡ አንሥአ ፡ ወረሰየ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ክርስቲያን ፤
sentences.l: and-as Solomon he-built house-of God thus Christ-indeed he-raised-up and-he-made body-his house-of Christian
sentences.i: And as Solomon built the house of God, so Christ also raised up and made his body a church;
sentences.n: ወበከመ ... ከማሁ is the correlative 'and just as ... so'; በከመ = በ- 'in' + ከመ 'as'. ሐነጸ 'built' (3ms perfect); ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'house-of God' is a construct chain, the Temple (1 Kings 6). ክርስቶስኒ: enclitic -ኒ 'also, indeed', as with -ሂ, -ሰ elsewhere. አንሥአ 'raised up' and ረሰየ 'made, set' (3ms perfects); ሥጋሁ 'body-his'. ቤተ ክርስቲያን is literally 'house-of Christian(s)', the ordinary word for church. The raising prepares the saying in the next unit.

sentences.t: ወበከመ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ ለአይሁድ ፡ ንሥትዎ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ቤት ፡ ወበሠሉስ ፡ ዕለት ፡ አሐንጾ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ሥጋሁ ።
sentences.l: and-as he-said-to-them to-Jews destroy-it to-this house and-in-third day I-will-build-it for he-said-to-them concerning house-of body-his
sentences.i: And as he said to the Jews, 'Destroy this house, and on the third day I will build it,' for he said it to them about the house of his body.
sentences.n: This alludes to John 2:19-21 (Jesus on the temple raised in three days); the Geʿez is rendered as it stands, with no other text consulted. ይቤሎሙ = ይቤ 'he said' + -ሎሙ 'to them'. ለአይሁድ: ለ- 'to'. ንሥትዎ: plural imperative + -ዎ 'it'; the verb (ነሠተ 'tear down'?) is uncertain (?). ለዝንቱ ቤት: ለ- marks the object. ወበሠሉስ ዕለት 'and on the third day' (ሠሉስ 'third'; በ- 'on'). አሐንጾ: 1st person singular imperfect (ʾa-) of ሐነጸ + -o 'it', 'I shall build it'. ቤተ ሥጋሁ 'house-of body-his' is a construct chain with a possessive suffix on the last member.

sentences.t: ወበከመ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ አብዝኀ ፡ አንስተ ፡ እምሕዝበ ፡ ነኪር ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሥኖን ፡ ወላሕዮን ፡ ወበአምስሎ ፡ አፍቅሮ ፡ ፍትወታት ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ክርስቶስኒ ፡ አስተጋብአ ፡ እምሕዝበ ፡ ነኪር ፡ እለ ፡ አልቦሙ ፡ ሕግ ፡ እለ ፡ አምኑ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ቈላፈ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ አረማዌ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ወአይሁዳዌ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ነባሬ ፡ ወአግዓዜ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ አስተጋብአ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ በሥጋሁ ፡ ወደሙ ፡ ወበመሓልየ ፡ መሓልይሂ ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ሐለየ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ዐራቱ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ፷ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ዐውዳ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ምሁራነ ፡ ቀትል ፡ እኁዛነ ፡ አስይፍት ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንቅዕቱ ፡ ሰይፈ ፡ ያነብር ፤
sentences.l: and-as Solomon he-multiplied women from-people-of foreign because-of beauty and-loveliness and-in-likeness(?)-his loving desires thus Christ-indeed he-gathered from-people-of foreign who not-to-them law who they-believed in-him which-not-is uncircumcised and-not-is pagan and-not-is slave and-Jew and-not-is resident(?) and-free all-of-them he-gathered into kingdom-of heavens by-body-his and-blood-his and-in-song-of songs-indeed himself Solomon he-meditated while he-says bed-his of-Solomon 60 mighty-men around-it all-of-them trained-ones-of war holders-of swords man man upon thigh(?)-his sword he-places
sentences.i: And as Solomon took many wives from a foreign people, because of beauty and loveliness and in his love (?) of desires, so Christ also gathered from a foreign people, those who had no law, who believed in him, in whom there is no uncircumcised, no pagan, no slave or Jew, no resident or free: all of them he gathered into the kingdom of heaven by his body and his blood. And in the Song of Songs Solomon himself, meditating, said: 'Solomon’s bed: sixty mighty men are around it, all of them trained in war, holding swords, each man placing a sword upon his thigh (?).'
sentences.n: A long unit (about 63 words) with no ፤ inside it to cut at, so kept whole. Pattern ወበከመ ... ከማሁ again. አብዝኀ አንስተ 'multiplied women' (causative of በዝኀ), 'took many wives' in the English. እምሕዝበ ነኪር 'from a people-of foreign' (እም- 'from'; construct; ነኪር 'foreign, stranger'): the foreign wives of 1 Kings 11. ሥኖን 'beauty', ላሕዮን 'loveliness' (both probable, no Dillmann (?)). ወበአምስሎ አፍቅሮ ፍትወታት is obscure as printed. አምስሎ may be a corrupt or rare form near አምሳል 'likeness' (?); its ending -ሎ would be 'to him', not 'his', so 'in-likeness(?)-his' in the interlinear is a placeholder only (?). አፍቅሮ I take as the infinitive of አፍቀረ 'love' (the same spelling is the imperative + 'him' in a published entry) with ፍትወታት 'desires, pleasures' as its object; 'his love of desires' is the sense the sentence needs, uncertain (?). እለ አልቦሙ ሕግ 'who there-is-not to-them law' (አልቦ + ሙ 'to them' = 'they have no'). ቦቱ 'in-him'. ዘአልቦ ... 'which has no ...' (ዘ- is singular, so its antecedent is ቦቱ 'in him', Christ, not እለ 'those who'): 'in whom there is no ...' echoes Galatians 3:28 and Colossians 3:11 (no Jew nor Greek, slave nor free); ቈላፈ 'uncircumcised' (Gentile), አረማዌ 'pagan', ገብረ 'slave', አይሁዳዌ 'Jew', ነባሬ 'resident, dweller' (?), አግዓዜ 'free man'. Pairing is as printed (ወአልቦ ገብረ ወአይሁዳዌ), so 'neither slave nor Jew' fits the sense less cleanly than Galatians would (?). ሰማያት 'heavens' (plural form). ወደሙ = ወ + ደሙ 'and his blood'. መሓልየ መሓልይ is the construct 'song-of songs' = Song of Songs; -ሂ 'indeed'. ለሊሁ 'himself'. ሐለየ 'meditated' (also 'sang, composed') (?). Song of Songs 3:7-8: the 'sixty mighty men' around Solomon’s bed, each with sword at thigh. ዐራቱ 'his bed' (ዐራት 'bed' + -ሁ, anticipating ለሰሎሞን 'of Solomon'); printed with ዐ. ዐውዳ 'around it': the noun ዐውድ 'circuit' + -ሃ 'it/her', used as a preposition, as in the published entry; not a verb. ምሁራነ 'taught ones' (plural of ምሁር) in construct with ቀትል 'war'; እኁዛነ 'holders-of', plural, construct with አስይፍት 'swords'. ብእሲ ብእሲ 'each man'. መንቅዕቱ 'his ...': the word is not one I can confirm, and its ending -ቱ would fit a noun in -ት + -ሁ rather than መንቅዕ (?); I think it is usually 'spring, source' (?), and 'thigh' is a guess from the sword-bearing scene of Song of Songs 3:7-8, not from the word (?). ያነብር 'he places' (causative አነበረ; jussive form, as in the published entry), 'each man ... places a sword' in the English.

sentences.t: ፷ ፡ ብሂል ፡ በኆልቈ ፡ አርእስተ ፡ አበው ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ ወነቢያት ፡ ወሐዋርያት ፡ ወሰማዕት ፡ ወመሀይምናን ፡ ወቅዱሳን ፡ ወመነኮሳት ፡ እለ ፡ የአብይዎ ፡ ለኅሊና ፡ እኩይ ፡ ፀብአ ፡ ሰይጣን ፤
sentences.l: 60 saying by-number-of heads-of fathers righteous and-prophets and-apostles and-martyrs and-believers and-saints and-monks who they-resist-it to-thought evil war-of Satan
sentences.i: 'Sixty' is said to be the number of the chief fathers: the righteous, the prophets, the apostles, the martyrs, the faithful, the saints, and the monks, who resist (?) the evil thought, the warfare of Satan;
sentences.n: The numeral ፷ 60 is read as the thing explained, with ብሂል 'is said (to be)' as before. በኆልቈ 'by the number-of' (ኆልቈ 'number, counting'; construct before አርእስተ 'heads-of'), a construct chain አርእስተ አበው 'heads-of fathers' (the elders, leaders). The list is joined by ወ-: ጻድቃን, ነቢያት, ሐዋርያት, ሰማዕት, መሀይምናን, ቅዱሳን, መነኮሳት (all plurals: ነቢያት, ሐዋርያት, መነኮሳት in -āt; ጻድቃን, ቅዱሳን, መሀይምናን in -ān; ሰማዕት I read as plural 'martyrs' (?)); ጻድቃን could instead agree with አበው, 'righteous fathers', so the list would begin at ነቢያት (?). የአብይዎ: ይ- 3mp + አበየ 'refuse, resist' (?) + -ዎ 'it'; 'resist' fits the war imagery, but the lexical call is made without Dillmann (?). ለኅሊና እኩይ 'the evil thought': ለ- marks the object; ኅሊና 'thought', እኩይ 'evil'. ፀብአ ሰይጣን 'war-of Satan', apposition: either 'the evil thought, the war of Satan' or 'evil thought; Satan’s war'. ሰይጣን is the Hebrew-derived name Satan.

sentences.t: ወሰይፍሂ ፡ ይተረጐም ፡ ቃለ ፡ መጻሕፍት ፡ ከመ ፡ መላጼ ፡ በሊኅ ፡ ዘርቱዕ ፡ ይመትር ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይመትሩ ፡ እምልቦሙ ፡ ድንጋፄ ፡ ለያልይ ፡ ዘሕልመ ፡ ሐሰት ፤
sentences.l: and-sword-indeed it-is-interpreted word-of books as razor(?) sharp which-right it-cuts word-of God thus they-cut-off from-heart-their terror of-dreamer(?) of-dream-of falsehood
sentences.i: And the sword is interpreted as the word of the Scriptures, like a sharp razor that cuts the word of God straight (?); so they cut from their hearts the terror of the one who dreams a false dream (?);
sentences.n: -ሂ 'indeed' on ሰይፍ, picking up the sword of the Song. ይተረጐም is the passive-reflexive (ተ-) of ተርጐመ 'interpret', so 'is interpreted'. ቃለ መጻሕፍት 'word-of books' = scripture (መጻሕፍት 'books', a plural). ከመ 'as, like'. መላጼ 'razor' (from ላጸ 'shave') and በሊኅ 'sharp' are probable (?). ዘርቱዕ 'which (is) right, straight'; whether it is adverbial 'straight' or describes the razor is open (?). Hebrews 4:12 (the sharp word) may lie behind the image. ይመትር 'cuts' (መተረ 'cut off'). ከማሁ ... 'thus'. እምልቦሙ 'from heart-their' (እም- 'from'; ልብ 'heart'; -ሙ 'their'). ድንጋፄ 'terror, fright' perhaps echoes the 'fear in the night' of Song of Songs 3:8. ለያልይ ዘሕልመ ሐሰት: ለ- here marks the possessor (as in ዐራቱ ለሰሎሞን), 'of the one-who ... of-dream-of falsehood'; ያልይ I take as 'dreamer' but this is the least secure word of the unit (?).

sentences.t: ወዐራተ ፡ ሰሎሞንሰ ፡ ምስካቡ ፡ ይተረጐም ፡ በቤተ ፡ ክርስቲያኑ ፡ ለክርስቶስ ።
sentences.l: and-bed-of Solomon-indeed couch-his it-is-interpreted in-house-of Christian-his of-Christ
sentences.i: As for the bed of Solomon, his couch is interpreted as the church of Christ.
sentences.n: ዐራተ is ዐራት 'bed' in the construct state (ending -ä), 'bed-of Solomon'; -ሰ 'as for, indeed' marks the topic. ምስካቡ 'his couch' (ምስካብ, from ሰከበ 'lie down'; the published entry has 'bed, couch'); the -ሁ is Solomon’s, resuming the topic. በቤተ ክርስቲያኑ ለክርስቶስ: 'in-house-of Christian-his of-Christ', that is 'in his church, Christ’s' (በ- 'in', rendered 'as' in the English); ለ- marks the possessor, with -ሁ anticipating it, the same pattern as ዐራቱ ለሰሎሞን. Printed ዐራተ with ዐ.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ሐለየ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ መጾረ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ለርእሱ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፤
sentences.l: and-again he-meditated while he-says palanquin(?) he-made for-head-his king Solomon
sentences.i: And again he spoke in meditation, saying: 'King Solomon made himself a litter (?).'
sentences.n: Song of Songs 3:9 (a carrying-chair or litter). ካዕበ 'again, a second time'. መጾረ 'carrier, palanquin' (from ጾረ 'carry') (?). ገብረ 'made' (3ms; the object precedes the verb). ለርእሱ 'for his head', the idiom for 'for himself' (ርእስ 'head, self'). ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን is the subject placed last for emphasis.

sentences.t: ወዝንቱሂ ፡ ተተርጐመ ፡ ከመ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ለብሰ ፡ ሥጋነ ፤
sentences.l: and-this-indeed it-was-interpreted that Christ he-put-on body-our
sentences.i: And this too has been interpreted: that Christ put on our body.
sentences.n: ተተርጐመ is the perfect of ተርጐመ 'interpret' (passive, ተ- prefix), 'it was interpreted'; contrast ይተረጐም 'is interpreted' above. ከመ 'that' introduces the content. ለብሰ 'put on, clothed himself in' (the incarnation as putting on flesh); ሥጋነ 'body-our'.

sentences.t: ሰሎሞን ፡ ብሂል ፡ በነገረ ፡ ዕብራዊያን ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ብሂል ።
sentences.l: Solomon saying in-speech-of Hebrews Christ saying
sentences.i: 'Solomon' means, in the speech of the Hebrews, 'Christ'.
sentences.n: Repeats the equation of the first unit; ነገረ ዕብራዊያን 'speech-of Hebrews' is a construct chain (ዕብራዊያን 'Hebrews'). The claim is the author’s, not a real etymology (Solomon is from Hebrew shalom, 'peace'). The sentence has no ወ or እስመ; I read it as a plain restatement.

sentences.t: ወአብዳንሰ ፡ አይሁድ ፡ ያመስልዎ ፡ ለቃለ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ዘተብህለ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወልዲ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይቤለኒ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወአነ ፡ ዮም ፡ ወለድኩከ ።
sentences.l: and-fools-indeed Jews they-liken-it to-word-of David which-was-said concerning Solomon my-son God he-said-to-me my-son you and-I today I-begot-you
sentences.i: But the foolish Jews liken the word of David, which was said about Solomon, 'my son': 'God said to me, You are my son, and today I have begotten you.'
sentences.n: ወአብዳንሰ 'and the fools, as for them' (አብዳን plural of አብድ 'fool'; -ሰ topic marker). ያመስልዎ: ይ- 3mp of አመሰለ 'liken, compare' + -ዎ 'it', with ለቃለ ዳዊት 'the word-of David' as its object (ለ- marking the object, doubled by -ዎ 'it', the house pattern). ዘተብህለ: ዘ- 'which' + ተብህለ 'was said' (passive of ይቤ). ወልዲ 'my son' (printed ወልዲ, a variant of ወልድየ) is read as David’s own words about Solomon; the ambiguity of ወልዲ is flagged (?). The quotation is Psalm 2:7 ('You are my son; today I have begotten you'). ይቤለኒ = ይቤ + ለ- + -ኒ 'he said to me'. ወለድኩከ 'I begot you': ወለደ 'beget', with 1st-person -ኩ and -ከ 'you' (masculine). ዮም 'today'. The Jews apply the Psalm to Solomon; the author applies it to Christ.

sentences.t: እግዚኦ ፡ ኵነኔከ ፡ ሀቦ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ወጽድቅከ ፡ ለወልደ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኰንኖሙ ፡ ለሕዝብከ ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ወለነዳያኒከኒ ፡ በፍትሕ ፡ ወየሐዩ ፡ ወይሁብዎ ፡ እምወርቀ ፡ ዐረብ ፡ ወዘልፈ ፡ ይጼልዩ ፡ በእንቲአሁ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ይድኅርዎ ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ምስማከ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ምድር ፡ ውስተ ፡ አርእስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ ወይነውኅ ፡ እምአርዝ ፡ ፍሬሁ ፡ ወይበቊል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገር ፡ ከመ ፡ ሣዕረ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ቡሩክ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ሀሎ ፡ ስሙ ፤
sentences.l: O-Lord judgment-your give-him to-king and-righteousness-your to-son-of king that he-may-judge-them to-people-your in-righteousness and-to-poor-your-indeed in-justice and-they-shall-live and-they-shall-give-him from-gold-of Arabia and-continually they-pray for-sake-his and-all day they-follow(?)-him and-it-shall-be support to-all earth on heads-of mountains and-it-shall-be-tall than-cedar fruit-his and-it-shall-sprout in city like grass-of earth and-it-shall-be blessed name-his for-ever before sun existed name-his
sentences.i: 'O Lord, give your judgment to the king, and your righteousness to the king’s son, that he may judge your people in righteousness and your poor also in justice. And they shall live, and they shall give him of the gold of Arabia, and they shall pray continually for him, and all day long they shall follow (?) him. And there shall be a support (?) for all the earth on the tops of the mountains, and his fruit shall be taller than the cedar, and it shall sprout in the city like the grass of the earth. And his name shall be blessed for ever; before the sun his name existed.'
sentences.n: Psalm 72 (71 in the Greek and Ethiopic numbering), verses 1-2 and 10-17, quoted with some verses skipped and others adapted, in the author’s own text of the Psalter; wording follows the Geʿez, not any English Psalter. Over the 45-word guide but no ፤ inside it to cut at. እግዚኦ 'O Lord' (vocative). ኵነኔከ 'judgment-your' (-ከ 'your'). ሀቦ 'give' (imperative) with ለንጉሥ 'to the king'. ወልደ ንጉሥ 'son-of king' (construct). ከመ ይኰንኖሙ 'that he may judge them' (subjunctive ይኰንን + -ሙ). ለነዳያኒከኒ 'and your poor, too' (ነዳያን 'poor'; -ኒ). ይሁብዎ 'they shall give him'. ወርቀ ዐረብ 'gold-of Arabia' (the gold of Sheba, Psalm 72:15). ይጼልዩ 'they pray' (ጸለየ). በእንቲአሁ 'for his sake'. ይድኅርዎ: ድኅረ 'be behind, follow' + -ዎ 'him', 'they follow him'; the verb sits oddly in this setting and I give it as it stands (?). ምስማከ 'support' (?) (cf. ሰመከ 'lean'; the published entry has 'nails (?)', but the same corpus glosses መሳምክት as 'supports', so the entry should be broadened). ወየሐዩ 'and they shall live' (ሐይወ, 3mp). ዘልፈ 'continually'. ኵሎ አሚረ 'all day' (accusative of time). እምአርዝ: እም- 'than' (comparative), አርዝ 'cedar'. ወይበቊል 'it shall sprout' (3ms; the subject is not stated). ሀሎ here 'existed' (perfect; the published entry gives 'is'). ይነውኅ 'is tall, exalted' (ነወኀ). ይበቊል 'sprouts' (በቈለ). ሣዕረ ምድር 'grass-of earth'. ቡሩክ 'blessed'. እምቅድመ ፀሐይ 'before the sun' (እም- + ቅድመ, construct with ፀሐይ). Christians read the pre-existence of the name as Christ’s eternal being.

sentences.t: ወለድኩከ ፡ እምከርሥ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ኮከበ ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ መሐለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወኢይኔስሕ ፡ አንተ ፡ ካህኑ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ በከመ ፡ ሢመቱ ፡ ለመልከ ፡ ጼዴቅ ።
sentences.l: I-begot-you from-womb before star-of morning he-swore God and-not-he-will-repent you priest-his for-ever according-to order-his of-Melchi zedek
sentences.i: 'I begot you from the womb before the morning star. God has sworn, and he will not repent: You are his priest for ever (?), according to the order of Melchizedek.'
sentences.n: Psalm 110:3-4 (109 in the Geʿez/Greek numbering), the verses quoted of the king who is also priest. ወለድኩከ again 'I begot you'. እምከርሥ 'from the womb' (ከርሥ 'belly, womb'). ኮከበ ጽባሕ 'star-of morning' (construct). መሐለ 'swore' (3ms) and ወኢይኔስሕ 'and will not repent' (negative ኢ-, ነስሐ). አንተ ካህኑ ለዓለም: ካህን 'priest' + -ሁ 'his', 'you, his priest'; but ለዓለም can also name the owner after an anticipating suffix (the published entry), as in ሢመቱ ለመልከ ጼዴቅ just after, so 'priest for ever' against 'priest of the world' is open (?). በከመ ሢመቱ ለመልከ ጼዴቅ: ሢመት 'appointment, order, rank' with -ሁ 'his', followed by ለ- possessor ('his order, Melchizedek’s'). መልከ ጼዴቅ is written as two words; the interlinear splits the name 'Melchi-zedek'. Hebrews 5-7 gives the Christian reading of Melchizedek as a type of Christ.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ወዘይመስሎ ፡ ትንቢት ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ዘተነበየ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ይብሉ ፡ አብዳን ፡ ዕዉራነ ፡ ልብ ፡ አይሁድ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ መጽሐፉ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወልዲ ፡ ዘተናገረ ፤
sentences.l: and-this and-what-resembles-it prophecy which-concerning Christ which-he-prophesied David they-say fools blind-ones-of heart Jews he-said David in head-of book-his concerning Solomon my-son which-he-spoke
sentences.i: The foolish Jews, blind of heart, say: 'This and what resembles it, the prophecy about Christ which David prophesied, David said at the head of his book about Solomon, my son, in what he spoke';
sentences.n: ዘንተ ወዘይመስሎ 'this and that which resembles it' (ይመስሎ 'it resembles it'; ዘ- relative). ትንቢት ዘበእንተ ክርስቶስ 'a prophecy which is concerning Christ' (ዘበእንተ: ዘ- + በእንተ). ዘተነበየ 'which he prophesied' (ተነበየ 'prophesy', ተ- stem). ዕዉራነ ልብ 'blind-ones-of heart' is a construct chain (ዕዉር 'blind', plural in -ነ). ርእሰ መጽሐፉ 'head-of book-his', the opening of the Psalter, as the Psalms are David’s book. ዘተናገረ 'which he spoke' (ተናገረ). ይመስሎ is ይመስል + -ሎ 'to it' (መሰለ takes ለ-). The Geʿez is one long sentence: ይብሉ 'they say' introduces ይቤ ዳዊት 'David said', and ዘተናገረ 'what he spoke' closes it, so the English is a little loose (?).

sentences.t: ዘንተ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ አይሁድ ፡ ወያመስልዎ ፡ ለክርስቶስ ፡ በሰሎሞን ፡ በመኵሴ ፡ ስም ፡ በጥበብ ፡ ወበወልደ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ በሥጋ ።
sentences.l: this they-say Jews and-they-liken to-Christ with-Solomon in-መኵሴ(?) name in-wisdom and-in-son-of David in-flesh
sentences.i: This the Jews say, and they liken Christ to Solomon in name (?), in wisdom, and as son of David in the flesh.
sentences.n: ወያመስልዎ ለክርስቶስ 'and they liken Christ' (ለ- marks the object) 'to Solomon' (በ- 'with' in the interlinear), in respects each introduced by በ- 'in'. በመኵሴ ስም: መኵሴ is not a word I can identify (?), so my 'in name' is the sense the context asks for ('in a [shared] name') and not a lexical result (?). በጥበብ 'in wisdom'. ወበወልደ ዳዊት በሥጋ 'and as son-of David in flesh' (ወልደ in construct with ዳዊት), the Davidic descent (Matthew 1:1; Romans 1:3). The author concedes the likeness, but only as a type.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ አእመሩ ፡ እለ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወሰሎሞን ፡ ኤልያስ ፡ ወኤልሳዕ ፡ ጸሐፉ ፡ ኀጢአቶ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጽሐፈ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ ከመ ፡ ያስተኀፍርዎሙ ፡ ለአይሁድ ፡ ዕዉራነ ፡ ልብ ፡ ጸራ ፡ ለጽድቅ ።
sentences.l: and-this after they-knew who after David and-Solomon Elijah and-Elisha they-wrote sin-his of-Solomon in book-of kings that they-may-put-to-shame-them to-Jews blind-ones-of heart enemies to-righteousness
sentences.i: And after those who came after David and Solomon, Elijah and Elisha, had learned this, they wrote Solomon’s sin in the Book of Kings, so as to shame the Jews, blind of heart, enemies of righteousness (?).
sentences.n: ወዘንተ እምድኅረ አእመሩ 'and this, after they knew' (አእመረ 'know'); እለ እምድኅረ ዳዊት ወሰሎሞን 'those who (were) after David and Solomon', then named in apposition, ኤልያስ ወኤልሳዕ Elijah and Elisha. The text itself credits Elijah and Elisha with writing the Book of Kings ( መጽሐፈ ነገሥት 'book-of kings', construct); the account of Solomon’s sin is 1 Kings 11. ኀጢአቶ 'sin-his' (ኀጢአት + -ሁ), with ለሰሎሞን 'of Solomon' following. ከመ ያስተኀፍርዎሙ: ከመ + subjunctive of the causative-reflexive አስተኀፈረ 'put to shame' + -ሙ 'them'; ለአይሁድ marks the object. ጸራ ለጽድቅ 'enemies to righteousness' (ጸር 'enemy', the form ጸራ, with a 4th-order ending, is not the plain accusative ጸረ, so its parse is uncertain; ለ- here 'of, to') (?).

sentences.t: ወሰሎሞንሰ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወነቢይ ፡ ወለሊሁኒ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወነቢይ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወበጥበብ ፡ ተነበየ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ አምሳለ ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ክርስቲያን ፡ ወጸሐፈ ፡ ፬ ፡ መጽሐፈ ፡ ትንቢቱ ፡ ውተኆለቈ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ወያዕቆብ ፡ ወዳዊት ፡ አቡሁ ፡ በመንግሥተ ፡ ሰማያት ፨
sentences.l: and-Solomon-indeed king son-of David king and-prophet and-himself-also king and-prophet he and-in-wisdom he-prophesied that-which-concerning Christ many likenesses and-concerning house-of Christian and-he-wrote 4 book-of prophecy-his and-he-was-numbered with Abraham Isaac and-Jacob and-David father-his in-kingdom-of heavens
sentences.i: As for Solomon, a king, the son of David (a king and prophet), he himself also was a king and prophet; and in wisdom he prophesied many likenesses of Christ and of the church; and he wrote four books of his prophecy, and he was numbered with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and David his father, in the kingdom of heaven.
sentences.n: ወሰሎሞንሰ 'and as for Solomon' (-ሰ). ወልደ ዳዊት 'son-of David' (construct); ንጉሥ ወነቢይ after ዳዊት most naturally describes David, so ወለሊሁኒ says Solomon too is king and prophet; 'Solomon, son of David, king and prophet' is possible (?). ወለሊሁኒ 'and himself also' (-ኒ). ውእቱ 'he, is' (the copula). ተነበየ 'prophesied'. ዘበእንተ ክርስቶስ 'that which concerns Christ'. ብዙኀ አምሳለ 'many likenesses' (አምሳለ is the accusative singular of አምሳል 'likeness, type', after ብዙኅ 'many, much'; 'type' is the Christological word). ፬ 4 stays a numeral. ጸሐፈ ፬ መጽሐፈ ትንቢቱ 'wrote four books-of his-prophecy': the singular construct after ፬ is as printed; the four books are by Ethiopian reckoning Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, the Song of Songs and Wisdom, but the text does not name them (my note, not the text’s, and unchecked (?)). ውተኆለቈ is printed fused: ወ + ተኆለቈ with the ተ- reflexive/passive stem of ኆለቈ 'count', 'was numbered', which should be ወተኆለቈ; the printed ው is an oddity, kept as it stands. ምስለ 'with', then the three patriarchs, ወዳዊት አቡሁ 'and David father-his'. በመንግሥተ ሰማያት 'in the kingdom-of heavens'. Solomon’s salvation is affirmed here, as in the surrounding chapters on his sin. The unit ends with ፨, the end of the part.
